staticFrame.alt: A dark archival table seen from above. Source slips lie in three open case files, each corded to its origin at the table edge, and the ledger line where a verdict would be written is left blank.

scenes.label: 01 / The record
scenes.heading: Nothing here was placed by hand.
scenes.narration: Every file on this table is assembled from configured sources. No topic was picked, ordered, or framed by a person. The record organises what was said. It does not rule on whether it was true.

scenes.label: 02 / Sources
scenes.heading: Each source keeps its kind and its cord.
scenes.narration: A source is set down marked official, independent media, or citizen, with a cord back to where it came from. It is never promoted into the truth.

scenes.label: 03 / Behind a file
scenes.heading: The count is shown, so a reader can weigh it.
scenes.narration: This file rests on two sources, both independent media. No official record and no citizen account has been logged against it. The gap is shown, not hidden.

scenes.label: 04 / Claims ledger
scenes.heading: Who said it, and where.
scenes.narration: Every claim keeps a cord to the source that made it. What each side said sits side by side, at equal weight. No verdict, only the citation.

scenes.label: 05 / The file
scenes.heading: Kept together. Not fused.
scenes.narration: Related sources sit in one file under a loose cord that never cinches. The file carries its own source count and the split across official, media, and citizen.

scenes.label: 06 / How many voices
scenes.heading: One publisher ran through every file.
scenes.narration: On this date the independent-media side of every file traced back to a single publisher. The record does not fold that into a headline. It shows the number of sources so the reader can see it.

scenes.label: 07 / The boundary
scenes.heading: Open questions stay open.
scenes.narration: Where only one side has spoken, the file holds an open question. Not an accusation, a status. Where a primary government document confirms a claim, it is logged as a verifiable fact. The verdict slab comes down and leaves no mark.

scenes.label: 08 / Deep dive
scenes.heading: The conclusion is yours.
scenes.narration: The record runs past where you stopped reading. Every row can be challenged, and the history of corrections is kept and never rewritten. The case study carries the ingestion, the identity model, the citation graph, and why the verdict was removed from the contract.

audio.explanation: This world is a silent archival demonstration. It has no audio asset and makes no audio request.
